What to buy first

Every Saturday the weekend market opens at the old station square. Vendors set up wooden crates of oranges, baskets of herbs, and paper bags full of honey.

Arrive before nine to get the freshest bread from the stone oven. The baker wraps each loaf in brown paper and ties it with string.

Walk the second aisle for the cheese stall, where a woman with a striped apron lets you taste everything before you choose.

If you stay until noon, the musicians set up under the clock tower and the whole square smells like cinnamon and grilled corn.
